name: PufferGo
author: puffergo

sections.description:
PufferGo is an AI website builder crafted by a team of senior engineers from top-tier tech companies. Powered by world-leading large language models, it helps you rapidly generate beautiful websites optimized for Google SEO—empowering businesses to easily build their online presence for global markets.
PufferGo 是一款由一线互联网大厂工程师团队打造的 AI 建站工具，专为外贸企业和 B2B 出海商家设计。无需编程基础，输入业务信息即可由 AI 自动分析需求、规划网站结构、生成精美页面，一站式完成外贸独立站搭建。支持中文理解，提供完整的中文支持和微信客服。

Why Choose PufferGo?

  • 🌏 Optimized for Export & B2B – Purpose-built for international trade and B2B business scenarios.
  • 🔍 Google SEO Friendly – Semantic code structure that search engines love.
  • ⚡ Zero Coding Required – No technical background needed. Launch your site in as little as one day.
  • 📱 Fully Responsive – Perfect display on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • 🚀 Blazing Fast Performance – Clean, minimal code for instant page loads.
  • 🤖 Top-Tier AI Models – Integrated with world-leading large language models.

Core Features

  • AI Requirements Analysis – Input your business info, and AI organizes your website requirements automatically.
  • Smart Sitemap Generation – Auto-generates site structures following Silo architecture best practices.
  • Intelligent Block Planning – Plans optimal page layouts based on each page’s goals.
  • One-Click Website Generation – AI generates complete pages instantly.
  • Flexible Editing Options – Supports manual editing, AI-assisted editing, or importing HTML from other AI tools.
  • Theme Compatible – Works seamlessly with your WordPress theme styles.

Documentation & Support

  • 📖 Documentation: puffergo.com/docs
  • 💬 Chinese Support: We provide comprehensive Chinese support to help Chinese businesses go global.
  • 📧 Email / 邮箱: tech@puffergo.com
  • 💬 WeChat / 微信: 联系我们获取微信

External Services

This plugin utilizes PufferGo AI services (api.puffergo.com) to provide artificial intelligence features:

  • Content Generation: Sends prompts to generate text and layouts.
  • Template Sync: Fetches the latest design patterns from our cloud library.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

This plugin supports optional third-party analytics services that are disabled by default and require manual activation:

Google Tag Manager

  • Service: Google Tag Manager
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Google’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Google Privacy Policy and Google Terms of Service

Baidu Analytics (百度统计)

  • Service: Baidu Analytics (百度统计)
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns for Chinese markets.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Baidu’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Baidu Privacy Policy and Baidu Terms of Service
sections.installation:
1. Search for PufferGo in WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New, or manually upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/puffergo.
  2. Activate PufferGo in the Plugins page.
  3. Go to the PufferGo settings page to connect your account and start building.
sections.faq:
Is PufferGo free to use?

Yes, we offer a free tier that’s enough to create a complete website. More advanced features are available with paid plans.

Do I need to know how to code?

Not at all. We’ve eliminated all technical barriers, and top-tier AI models from both China and the US are here to assist you. If you run into any issues, feel free to contact us—we’re happy to help. Of course, if you do have technical skills, you’ll find it even smoother to use, but the difference isn’t huge.

How does it help with SEO?

We generate Tailwind HTML code that’s extremely clean and loads incredibly fast. Unlike traditional website builders (like Elementor), there’s no bloated, redundant code.

Where is the data stored?

Only your account-related data is stored on our cloud servers. All other data remains on your own server.
sections.changelog:
0.9.91

  • Showroom One-Click Preview & Import — New showroom feature lets you preview and import professionally designed page templates with one click. Includes guided setup strip, FSE (Full Site Editing) theme detection with helpful migration prompts, and automatic cleanup on import.
  • Auto-Activate Header, Footer & Page Templates on Import — When importing a showroom template, PufferGo now automatically activates the matching PufferGo Header/Footer menu locations and page templates, so your site looks complete right away — no manual setup required.
  • Showroom Import: Footer Menu, Apple Design Preset & UX Polish — Imported showroom pages now include properly structured footer navigation menus. Added Apple-inspired design preset for a clean, modern aesthetic. Fixed modal and button state issues during the import flow for a smoother experience.
  • Fixed: WP_Hook Iteration Warning on Fresh Installs — Resolved a PHP warning that could appear in the WordPress admin on brand-new sites when iterating over hook callbacks. The admin dashboard now loads cleanly without any warnings.

0.9.91 (中文版)

  • 样板间一键预览与导入 — 全新样板间功能，支持一键预览和导入专业设计的页面模板。包含引导条、FSE（全站编辑）主题检测与迁移提示，以及导入后自动清理临时数据。
  • 导入时自动激活 Header、Footer 和页面模板 — 导入样板间模板时，PufferGo 会自动激活对应的 PufferGo Header/Footer 菜单位置和页面模板，站点导入即完整，无需手动配置。
  • 样板间导入：Footer 菜单、Apple 设计预设与体验优化 — 导入的样板间页面现包含结构化的底部导航菜单。新增 Apple 风格设计预设，呈现简洁现代的视觉效果。修复了导入流程中弹窗和按钮状态的异常，体验更流畅。
  • 修复：全新站点后台 WP_Hook 迭代警告 — 修复了在全新 WordPress 站点后台可能出现的 PHP 钩子迭代警告，管理后台现在加载正常，无任何警告信息。

0.9.90

  • More Reliable Page Section Previews — Fixed an issue where the design block preview could appear blank in certain environments. Section thumbnails and previews now load correctly from local plugin assets, ensuring a smooth editing experience regardless of server configuration.
  • Improved Stability Under High Load — Optimized the page rendering pipeline to reduce client-side processing, improving load consistency and responsiveness for sites with many AI-generated sections.
  • Under-the-Hood Reliability Improvements — Streamlined the internal component loading system and standardized how local environment detection works, resulting in fewer edge-case errors and more predictable behavior across different hosting setups.

0.9.90 (中文版)

  • 区块预览加载更稳定 — 修复了在特定服务器环境下设计区块预览图可能显示空白的问题。缩略图和预览现在从插件本地资源加载，确保无论服务器配置如何，编辑体验都流畅一致。
  • 高负载下页面更稳定 — 优化了页面渲染管线，减少客户端处理压力，让含有大量 AI 生成区块的页面加载更一致、响应更流畅。
  • 底层稳定性全面优化 — 精简了内部组件加载机制，统一了本地环境检测方式，减少边界条件下的错误，让插件在各类主机环境上的表现更加稳定可预期。

0.10.0

  • Floating Contact Widget for B2B Lead Generation — Keep your overseas buyers one tap away with a persistent floating contact button that appears across every page of your B2B website. Upload a WeChat QR code, add a WhatsApp link or phone number, and configure which pages it appears on — no coding required. The button automatically inherits your brand colors, so it blends seamlessly into your independent site design.
  • Quick Style & AI Edit — Visual Editing Without a Developer — Building a professional-looking export website no longer requires a web agency. Click any section on your page to open the editor: use Quick Edit to adjust spacing, colors, and fonts with sliders and pickers, or switch to AI Edit and describe the change in plain English (“make the hero background darker and the headline bigger”) to apply it instantly. Ideal for factory owners and trade teams who want full control over their site’s appearance.
  • 30+ New B2B Section Designs — Added a large library of professionally designed page sections purpose-built for B2B exporters and manufacturers: product feature showcases, factory video previews, certification and award grids, customer testimonial layouts, company timeline, multi-column download centers, and auto-playing carousels. Every section is mobile-responsive and optimized for international buyers browsing on any device.
  • Blog, Case Study & Team Archive Templates — Google rewards independent B2B websites that publish consistent, structured content. PufferGo now includes dedicated list and detail page templates for blogs, case studies, solution pages, customer testimonials, and team profiles — giving your export site the full content architecture that ranks. Set them up once; the AI page builder populates them automatically.
  • SEO-Safe Page Rendering for Google Indexing — Rewritten rendering engine ensures that every AI-generated page section outputs complete HTML at page load, not JavaScript-rendered content that crawlers may miss. This means your product descriptions, company story, and service pages are much more likely to be fully indexed by Google — critical for B2B independent sites targeting overseas search traffic. No additional SEO plugin configuration needed.
  • Faster AI Site Building with Auto SEO Meta — AI page generation now runs multiple pages in parallel, cutting full-site build time significantly. During the planning stage, the AI automatically drafts SEO-optimized titles and meta descriptions for every page based on your business profile and target market — saving hours of manual work for exporters launching a new independent website. Each page is built with international B2B buyer intent in mind.
  • Built-in Coming Soon Page — Launch your B2B independent site with confidence using the built-in coming soon page: fully styled, mobile-ready, and consistent with your brand design system. Display it while your full site is being built by the AI, so overseas buyers who land early see a professional holding page instead of a blank screen. Switch it off with one click when you’re ready to go live.

0.10.0 (中文版)

  • 浮动联系组件，抓住每一个海外询盘 — 在外贸独立站的每个页面添加常驻浮动联系按钮，让海外买家随时一键联系你。支持上传微信二维码、配置 WhatsApp 链接或电话号码，自定义显示页面范围，无需写代码。按钮自动适配网站品牌色，与整站风格浑然一体。
  • Quick Style 快编 + AI 编辑，工厂老板自己改网站 — 建一个专业的外贸独立站，不再需要找开发或设计公司。点击页面任意区块即可打开编辑器：用”快速编辑”直接调整间距、颜色、字体；切换到”AI 编辑”用中文描述你想要的效果，一键应用。外贸团队自己就能把网站改成想要的样子。
  • 30+ 个 B2B 专属设计区块 — 新增大批专为外贸出口商和制造商设计的页面区块：产品功能展示、工厂视频预览、认证与荣誉展示、客户评价布局、企业历程时间轴、多列资料下载中心、自动轮播图等。全部区块响应式适配，海外买家用任何设备浏览都能呈现专业效果。
  • 博客、案例、团队归档模板 — 谷歌会优先收录内容体系完整的外贸独立站。PufferGo 现已内置博客列表、案例研究、解决方案、客户评价和团队成员的专属列表与详情页模板，一套完整的 B2B 内容架构帮你提升 Google 排名。AI 建站自动填充内容，一次配置长期受益。
  • SEO 友好渲染，更容易被谷歌完整收录 — 重构页面渲染引擎，AI 生成的每个区块在页面加载时直接输出完整 HTML，不再依赖 JavaScript 动态渲染。你的产品描述、公司介绍和服务页面更容易被谷歌完整抓取和收录——对于做 Google SEO 的外贸独立站来说至关重要。无需额外配置 SEO 插件。
  • AI 建站提速，自动生成 SEO 元信息 — AI 建站改为多页并发执行，整站生成速度大幅提升。规划阶段 AI 会根据你的企业信息和目标市场，自动为每个页面生成 SEO 优化标题和 meta 描述，省去外贸人手动填写的大量时间。每个页面都针对海外 B2B 买家的搜索习惯进行优化。
  • 内置 Coming Soon 页，上线前也留下专业印象 — 用内置的维护中页面在正式上线前撑场面：完整品牌样式、移动端适配、与整站设计系统保持一致。AI 正在构建你的外贸独立站时，提前到访的海外买家看到的是专业的占位页，而不是空白屏幕。准备好了一键关闭，立即切换到正式站。

0.9.63

  • AI Site Builder — Existing Pages Protected — When running AI site building, if a homepage or blog page is already set in WordPress, PufferGo now detects and skips them instead of overwriting your settings. Menu updates are also incremental — only managed items are touched. The AI workflow default language has been changed to English for broader accessibility.
  • AI 建站保护已有页面设置 — 运行 AI 建站时，如果 WordPress 已设置了首页或博客页，PufferGo 会检测并跳过覆盖，保留你原有的配置。菜单更新改为增量模式，仅修改已管理的项目。AI 建站默认语言调整为 English，更好地服务多语言用户。

0.9.62

  • Customizable Product Archive URL — You can now set your own URL prefix for product listing pages (Settings > Permalinks > “Product archive base”). This avoids potential URL conflicts with WooCommerce and gives you full control over your product page structure.
  • 产品归档地址可自定义 — 现在可以自由设置产品列表页的 URL 前缀（设置 > 固定链接 > “Product archive base”），避免与 WooCommerce 产生链接冲突，让产品页地址完全按照你的意愿来。

0.9.61

  • Easier Product Category Management — Product categories now appear by default in Appearance → Menus, so you can add them to your website navigation without any extra setup.
  • Clearer Category Labels — Product category name updated to “PufferGo Categories” to avoid confusion with WooCommerce categories, making it more intuitive to use.
  • Smarter AI Site Building — Fixed an issue where running AI site building multiple times could create duplicate pages, ensuring your site stays clean and organized.
  • More Reliable Display — Resolved a conflict between custom color names and built-in system styles, ensuring your website displays correctly every time.

0.9.61 (中文版)

  • 产品目录，菜单添加更方便 — 现在”外观 → 菜单”中默认显示产品分类，无需额外设置即可直接将产品分类添加到网站导航中。
  • 产品名称区分更清晰 — 产品分类名称优化为”PufferGo 产品分类”，避免与 WooCommerce 分类混淆，操作更直观。
  • AI 建站更智能 — 优化了 AI 建站逻辑，多次运行不会再产生重复页面，避免网站出现多个博客页的异常情况。
  • 底层体验优化 — 修复了自定义颜色名称与系统内置样式冲突的问题，网站显示更加稳定可靠。

0.9.60

  • Smoother Code Editing — Significantly improved the HTML source code editor experience. Typing is now smooth and responsive, with no more browser freezes.
  • Complete Code After Refresh — Fixed an issue where the source code would appear truncated after page refresh. Full HTML is now displayed correctly every time.

  • More Stable Editor — Under-the-hood improvements for better overall stability and compatibility of the editing experience.

  • 编辑源码不再卡顿 — 大幅优化了”编辑源码”弹窗的编辑体验，打字流畅不卡顿，告别浏览器卡死的问题。

  • 刷新后源码显示完整 — 修复了页面刷新后源码内容被截断的问题，现在每次打开都能看到完整的 HTML 代码。
  • 编辑更稳定 — 优化了底层编辑逻辑，提升了编辑器的整体稳定性和兼容性。

0.9.59

  • Product Detail Page Fix — Fixed an issue where the “Specifications” section would show an empty title when no valid spec data was available.
  • Dashboard Buttons — Fixed button alignment in the admin dashboard for a cleaner look.

  • Editor Container — Fixed the editor container width so content doesn’t overflow the editing area.

  • 产品详情页修复 — 修复了”规格参数”区域在没有有效数据时会显示空标题的问题。

  • 后台按钮优化 — 修复了管理后台按钮的对齐方式，视觉更整齐。
  • 编辑器容器修复 — 修复了编辑器容器宽度问题，内容不再溢出编辑区域。

0.9.58

  • Auto-Create Blog Page — Automatically creates and registers the /blog page, making it accessible without going through the site builder flow again.

  • 自动补齐 Blog 页面 — 自动创建并注册 /blog 页面，使其可直接访问，无需重复走建站流程。

0.9.57

  • Access Control for Better Security — Granular permission system added, ensuring only authorized users can access sensitive operations. Enterprise-grade security for your website management.
  • No More Lost Progress on Timeout — Batch page generation now preserves completed results even if the request times out. No more waiting in vain — every successfully generated page is safely kept.

  • Fixed “Try to Fix” Editor Popup — Resolved an issue where the editor’s “Try to Fix” dialog would not behave correctly by removing the strip logic that interfered with user edits.

  • 新增权限控制 — 细粒度权限管理系统上线，确保只有授权用户才能执行敏感操作，为你的网站管理提供企业级安全保障。

  • 超时不丢失进度 — 批量生成页面时，即使请求超时，已完成的页面结果也会被保留。不再白白等待，每一页成功生成的成果都会妥善保存。
  • 修复编辑器 “尝试修复” 弹窗 — 移除了干扰用户编辑的 strip 逻辑，修复了编辑器 “尝试修复” 弹窗的异常行为。

0.9.56

  • Performance: Smaller CSS, Faster Pages — Our server-side Tailwind compilation pipeline now includes cssnano compression, further reducing stylesheet file sizes. Smaller CSS means faster page load times, better Core Web Vitals scores, and improved Google PageSpeed Insights results — all positive signals that search engines use to rank your website higher. Every kilobyte saved is a step closer to a better user experience and higher conversion rates.
  • New Icon Resources Added — A curated set of new icons has been added to enrich your website’s visual design options, helping you create more professional-looking pages without any extra design work.

  • Fixed: Product Pages Always Accessible After Plugin Reactivation — Resolved a rare issue where product archive pages could return 404 errors after deactivating and reactivating the plugin. We’ve added proper cleanup routines to ensure your product catalog and e-commerce pages remain fully crawlable by search engines at all times — because every 404 is a missed opportunity for organic traffic and potential customers.

  • 性能优化 — 更小的 CSS，更快的网站 — 服务端 Tailwind CSS 编译管线新增 cssnano 压缩，进一步减小样式表文件体积。更小的 CSS 意味着页面加载更快、Core Web Vitals 评分更高、Google PageSpeed Insights 表现更好——这些都是搜索引擎用来给网站排名的正向信号。每一 KB 的节省都是迈向更好用户体验和更高转化的一步。

  • 新增图标资源 — 精选一批新图标，丰富网站视觉设计选项，帮助你轻松打造更专业的页面效果。
  • 修复：插件重新激活后产品页始终可访问 — 修复了插件停用后重新激活时产品归档页偶发 404 的问题。新增了完善的清理机制，确保您的产品目录和电商页面始终可被搜索引擎正常抓取——因为每一个 404 都意味着错失的自然流量和潜在客户。

0.9.55

  • Fixed: Hostinger & CDN Compatibility — REST API Unified to POST — Resolved 403 errors caused by WAF (Web Application Firewall) on hosts like Hostinger intercepting PUT/DELETE requests. All REST API endpoints are now unified to POST, improving compatibility across various WordPress hosting environments.
  • Improved: Product Detail Page Template Upgrade — Product detail page template gets a visual and structural overhaul — better product information layout and optimized media gallery for more professional B2B product showcase and higher conversion rates.
  • Improved: AI Site Builder — Draft Preview & Site Structure Accessible — Draft pages can now be previewed directly after Step 5, and site structure pages are accessible for browsing. Check page results anytime during the building process to reduce rework.

  • Improved: Site Profile Data Sync — Site profile now stays in sync with Step 1 input, ensuring AI site generation always uses the latest brand information for more accurate content.

  • 修复：Hostinger 等 CDN 兼容性 — REST API 统一 POST — 解决部分主机商（如 Hostinger）CDN 的 WAF 拦截 PUT/DELETE 请求导致 403 的问题。所有 REST API 端点统一为 POST，提升建站在各类 WordPress 主机环境下的兼容性。

  • 改进：产品详情页模板升级 — 产品详情页模板视觉与结构全面升级，优化产品信息展示与多媒体画廊排版，B2B 外贸网站的产品展示更专业、转化更高效。
  • 改进：AI 建站流程 — 草稿页预览与站点结构可访问 — Step5 完成后草稿页可直接预览，站点结构页面可访问浏览，建站过程中随时检查页面效果，减少返工。
  • 改进：站点画像数据同步 — 站点画像与 Step1 填写的信息保持同步，确保 AI 建站使用最新的品牌信息，生成的网站内容更准确。

0.9.54

  • Improved: Template Management — Centralized Admin Panel — New “Template Settings” panel in the admin dashboard for one-stop configuration of global Header/Footer styles and per-layout blog content templates. Header and Footer template switching has been migrated from the frontend editor to the backend, providing a cleaner, more focused configuration experience.

  • Improved: Blog Content Templates — WordPress Theme Compatibility — Blog archive and single post pages now offer a “Theme Content” template option, rendering content using your active WordPress theme’s native styles. Fully compatible with popular themes like GeneratePress, Kadence, and Astra for maximum design flexibility.

  • 改进：模板管理系统 — 后台集中管理 — 新增后台「模板设置」面板，一站式配置全站 Header/Footer 样式和博客内容模板。Header 和 Footer 模板切换从页面编辑模式迁移至后台，操作更集中、配置更直观，告别反复切换页面的繁琐流程。

  • 改进：博客内容模板 — 适配 WordPress 主题 — 博客归档页和文章页新增「Theme Content」模板选项，可使用当前 WordPress 主题的原生样式渲染内容，完美兼容 GeneratePress、Kadence、Astra 等主流主题，建站灵活性再升级。

0.9.53

  • New: Blog System — Content Marketing Out of the Box — Full-featured blog with archive page (category filtering, full-text search, responsive article grid, AJAX pagination), article detail page (breadcrumb navigation, prev/next navigation, related posts), and seamless AJAX comments to boost reader engagement and dwell time.
  • Improved: Visual Editor — More Efficient Editing — New HTML source code editor modal with syntax highlighting for direct code editing and pasting external HTML. Fixed a bug where edits to multiple blocks could be lost during batch editing.

  • Improved: Sticky Header — Brand Always Visible — Navigation bar now uses sticky positioning, keeping the menu accessible while scrolling and reducing bounce rate.

  • 新功能：博客系统 — 内容营销开箱即用 — 一键拥有完整博客：归档页支持分类筛选和全文搜索，帮助访客快速找到感兴趣的内容；文章详情页自带相关推荐和上下篇导航，提升页面停留时间和 SEO 内链密度；无刷新评论系统，降低读者互动门槛，增强社区氛围。

  • 改进：可视化编辑器 — 改版更高效 — 新增 HTML 源码编辑弹窗，语法高亮，支持直接粘贴外部代码导入；修复多区块同时编辑时修改丢失的问题，批量调整更安心。
  • 改进：Header 吸顶 — 品牌始终可见 — 导航栏切换为吸顶模式，用户滚动浏览时导航始终可达，降低跳出率。

0.9.52

  • Refactor: Template Engine — Ground-up rewrite of the template rendering pipeline with a declarative registry, auto-discovery of header/footer variants, and thin route architecture. New variants drop-in with zero code changes. Cleaner separation of concerns improves long-term maintainability.
  • Refactor: Data/UI Separation — Introduced dedicated Data classes (PufferGo_Product_Data, PufferGo_Archive_Data, PufferGo_Header_Data, PufferGo_Footer_Data) to encapsulate all business logic. Templates are now pure presentation — thinner, testable, and easier to theme.
  • Refactor: CSS Architecture — Consolidated 6 CSS files into 4 with clear single responsibilities: puffergo.css (theme defense & layout), token-bridge.css (design token mapping), tailwind.css (compiled utilities), src/tailwind.css (build source, excluded from production). Eliminated 4 duplicated reset blocks into a single scoped defense layer. Reduced compiled Tailwind output by ~33% via unified scope prefix.
  • Fixed: Cross-Theme Compatibility — Extended button, input, textarea, and select element resets from header-only to all PufferGo-controlled areas (product archive, product detail, fullpage). Prevents theme style pollution from Kadence, GeneratePress, Astra and other popular themes. Scoped resets avoid !important, keeping Tailwind utility classes fully functional.
  • Fixed: CSS Load Order — Block-level Tailwind CSS now correctly declares dependency on template Tailwind CSS, preventing mobile-first base utilities from overriding responsive breakpoint utilities.
  • Fixed: Product Spec Accordion — Restored accordion toggle functionality on the product detail page. Added missing data-toggle attribute and plus/minus icon switching CSS.

  • Fixed: Contact Form i18n — Default field labels in the contact form block are now properly wrapped for translation.

  • 重构：模板引擎 — 模板渲染管线全面重写，采用声明式注册表 + 自动发现 header/footer 变体 + 薄路由架构。新增变体只需创建文件，零代码改动。关注点分离更清晰，长期可维护性显著提升。

  • 重构：数据/UI 分离 — 引入专用 Data 类（PufferGo_Product_Data、PufferGo_Archive_Data、PufferGo_Header_Data、PufferGo_Footer_Data）封装全部业务逻辑。模板回归纯展示层，更薄、更可测试、更易定制。
  • 重构：CSS 架构 — 6 个 CSS 文件合并为 4 个，职责单一：puffergo.css（主题防御与布局）、token-bridge.css（设计令牌映射）、tailwind.css（编译产物）、src/tailwind.css（构建源码，不打包进生产）。4 份重复防御代码合并为 1 个统一作用域，编译产物减少约 33%。
  • 修复：跨主题兼容性 — button、input、textarea、select 元素重置范围从仅 header 扩展到所有 PufferGo 区域（产品列表、产品详情、全页模板）。防御 Kadence、GeneratePress、Astra 等主流主题的样式污染。作用域重置不使用 !important，Tailwind utility 类正常生效。
  • 修复：CSS 加载顺序 — 区块级 Tailwind CSS 正确声明依赖模板 Tailwind CSS，避免 mobile-first 基础 utility 覆盖响应式断点 utility。
  • 修复：产品规格手风琴 — 恢复产品详情页规格参数的折叠/展开功能。补上缺失的 data-toggle 属性和图标切换 CSS。
  • 修复：联系表单国际化 — 联系表单区块的默认字段标签现已正确包裹翻译函数。

0.9.51

  • New: Product Video Gallery — Product listing and detail pages now support video in the gallery. Add product videos alongside images to showcase features more effectively — rich media content improves user engagement and dwell time, both positive signals for Google SEO ranking.
  • Improved: i18n Architecture — All translation keys migrated to English. Ready for WPML, Polylang, and other multilingual plugins. Contact form, design system, visual editor, and AI page builder are now fully translatable.
  • Fixed: Translation Scanner — Dynamic strings now use sprintf() instead of template literals, fixing incomplete translation extraction.
  • Fixed: Missing Text Domain — Added missing puffergo text domain in AI Page Builder.

  • Improved: Translation Files — Regenerated .po, .mo, .json with complete Chinese translations.

  • 新功能：产品视频画廊 — 产品列表页和详情页的 Gallery 现已支持视频。在产品图片中加入视频展示，更直观地呈现产品特性——丰富的多媒体内容提升用户参与度与页面停留时长，助力 Google SEO 排名。

  • 改进：国际化架构 — 所有翻译键统一为英文，兼容 WPML、Polylang 等多语言插件。联系表单、设计系统、可视化编辑器、AI 建站全部支持翻译。
  • 修复：翻译扫描 — 动态文案改用 sprintf()，修复翻译提取不全的问题。
  • 修复：缺失 Text Domain — 补充 AI Page Builder 中缺失的 text domain。
  • 改进：翻译文件 — 重新生成翻译文件，中文翻译补全。

0.9.50

  • Fixed: Site Profile Logo Upload — Resolved an issue where the site profile page could not upload or change the brand LOGO. The WordPress media library now loads correctly, ensuring smooth brand identity management across your entire site.
  • Fixed: Visual Editor Button Interaction — Fixed a bug in the SectionTree visual editor where clicking on action buttons had no response when a non-first element was selected. All editing controls now work reliably regardless of which section is active.
  • Fixed: Video Media Selection — The media picker in both the AI Edit Modal and PufferGo Tool now correctly supports video file selection, enabling richer multimedia content that improves user engagement and dwell time — both positive signals for search engine ranking.
  • Improved: AI Edit Image Reference — Optimized the image reference attachment flow for AI-assisted editing: limited to one reference image per request for more focused results, with clearer user feedback when the limit is reached.
  • Improved: Element ID Tracking — Enhanced the HTML preprocessing engine to correctly preserve and prefix element IDs when combining multiple blocks, preventing duplicate IDs and improving DOM structure quality for better SEO compliance.

  • Improved: Internationalization — Updated English and Chinese translation files with new media picker strings for video selection support.

  • 修复：站点画像 LOGO 上传 — 解决了站点信息页面无法上传或更换品牌 LOGO 的问题。WordPress 媒体库现在能正确加载，确保全站品牌标识管理顺畅无阻。

  • 修复：可视化编辑器按钮交互 — 修复了 SectionTree 可视化编辑器中，选中非首个元素时操作按钮无响应的问题。无论选中哪个区块，所有编辑控件现在都能正常工作。
  • 修复：视频媒体选择 — AI 编辑弹窗和 PufferGo 工具中的媒体选择器现已正确支持视频文件选择，方便添加更丰富的多媒体内容，提升用户参与度与页面停留时长——搜索引擎排名的正向信号。
  • 改进：AI 编辑图片参考 — 优化 AI 辅助编辑的图片参考附件流程：每次请求限制为一张参考图，聚焦生成更精准的结果，超出限制时提供明确提示。
  • 改进：元素 ID 追踪 — 增强 HTML 预处理引擎，在合并多个区块时正确保留并添加前缀元素 ID，避免重复 ID，提升 DOM 结构质量，更利于搜索引擎抓取与 SEO 合规。
  • 改进：国际化 — 更新英文和中文翻译文件，覆盖新增的视频选择相关文案。

0.9.45

  • New: Customer Inquiry Management System — Built-in WordPress contact form management module. Collect, view, and manage all customer inquiries from a dedicated admin panel with native Gutenberg block support — no third-party form plugin needed. Clean form markup improves Core Web Vitals scores.
  • New: In-Block Video Editing — Edit videos directly within the WordPress block editor without switching tools or re-uploading files. Encourages richer media content that increases dwell time — a positive signal for Google SEO ranking.
  • New: Smart Full-Screen Loading Experience — Professional full-screen loading overlay with randomized contextual tip messages during AI site generation. Reduces perceived wait time and decreases bounce rate for better user engagement metrics.
  • New: Default Page Template Configuration — Set a default page template from the PufferGo settings panel. Newly created pages automatically inherit the configured template, ensuring brand and layout consistency. Consistent page structure helps search engines crawl and index pages more efficiently.
  • Improved: Post-Publish Page Preview — Added a direct “View Page” button after AI site generation completes, eliminating extra navigation steps.
  • Improved: Streamlined Plugin Setup — Consolidated all setup functionality into the main Settings panel, removing the standalone plugin installation page for a cleaner admin sidebar.
  • Improved: Design System Integration — Comprehensive CSS architecture overhaul with Product CPT, unit config & formatter, nav menu helper refactor, CSS design tokens, and 60%+ reduction in theme bridge complexity.
  • Improved: Code Quality — Optimized DOM tree output for cleaner HTML, shared debounce utility, updated end-to-end test coverage.

  • Improved: Internationalization — Full translation coverage for English (en_US) and Chinese (zh_CN) across all new features.

  • 新功能：客户询盘管理系统 — 全新内置 WordPress 询盘与联系表单管理模块，后台集中管理客户询盘，原生 Gutenberg 区块支持，无需第三方表单插件。干净的表单标记提升 Core Web Vitals 评分。

  • 新功能：区块内视频编辑 — 在 WordPress 区块编辑器中直接编辑视频，无需切换工具或重新上传。更便捷的视频编辑鼓励产出更丰富的媒体内容，提升页面停留时长——搜索引擎排名的正向信号。
  • 新功能：全屏加载体验与智能进度提示 — 专业全屏加载界面替代静态转圈动画，AI 建站过程中持续展示进度信息与操作提示。降低感知等待时间，有效减少跳出率。
  • 新功能：默认页面模板配置 — 在 PufferGo 设置面板预设默认页面模板，新建页面自动继承已配置模板，确保全站品牌与布局一致性。统一的页面结构帮助搜索引擎更高效地抓取和索引。
  • 改进：发布后一键查看页面 — AI 建站完成后新增”查看页面”按钮，一键直达已发布页面。
  • 改进：插件安装流程合并至设置页 — 将安装配置功能整合到设置面板，移除独立安装页面，精简管理菜单。
  • 改进：设计系统集成 — 全面 CSS 架构升级：产品 CPT、单位配置与格式化、导航菜单重构、CSS 设计令牌、主题桥接代码量减少 60%+。
  • 改进：代码质量 — 优化 DOM 输出结构，减少冗余节点，生成更干净 HTML；新增共享 debounce 工具函数；更新端到端测试覆盖。
  • 改进：国际化 — 英文与中文翻译文件全面更新，所有新功能文案覆盖率达 100%。

0.9.40

  • Introduced PufferGo Product CPT — a lightweight WooCommerce alternative for faster product pages, boosting site speed and hitting the Google SEO sweet spot.
  • Dedicated PufferGo Header & Footer menu locations — menus stay intact when switching themes, no more rebuilding.
  • Step workflow now auto-creates product listing and blog archive pages and adds them to the navigation menu automatically.

  • Improved header experience and removed redundant code.

  • 注册 PufferGo Product 自定义文章类型，替代沉重的 WooCommerce，告别缓慢加载，网站速度飞起，直击 Google SEO 甜点。

  • 独立创建 PufferGo Header 和 PufferGo Footer 菜单位置，无惧更换主题，主题随意切换菜单不变。
  • Step 链路自动创建产品列表、博客列表页面并将产品列表和博客加入页面菜单中，菜单一次做好。
  • 优化 Header 体验，删除冗余代码。

0.9.31

  • Optimized core AI workflow with single batch request and polling pattern for improved stability and user experience.
  • Moved admin menu position to top of sidebar (below Dashboard) for easier access.
  • Improved form submission handling to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Enhanced thank-you page generation mechanism for better stability.
  • 优化核心 AI 流程，改用单次批量请求与轮询结果模式，提升稳定性与用户体验。
  • 调整后台菜单位置至侧栏顶部（仪表盘下方），更易访问。
  • 优化表单提交处理逻辑，确保信息稳定送达。
  • 优化感谢页生成机制，提高稳定性。
  • Streamlined the account authorization flow so users can authorize with one click from anywhere in the product.
  • 优化账号授权链路，方便用户从任何地方一键授权。
  • Improved site info and brand persona inputs with templates and examples for multiple scenarios so users can follow along easily.
  • 优化站点信息/品牌画像的输入，提供多种场景的模板和案例，用户依葫芦画瓢即可。
  • Added error reporting to make troubleshooting easier.
  • 上报错误信息，方便排查。
  • Optimized long-running AI requests with cloud-side caching and front-end polling to reduce timeouts when the server is geographically distant.
  • 优化 AI 长请求策略：采用云端缓存与前端轮询，避免因服务器距离过远导致超时。

0.9.2

  • When the account is not connected, improved guidance to connect first before starting AI site building.
  • Site profile: logo is selected from the Media Library (attachment ID with synced URL); updated size guidance (200–400 px width, upload 2× for retina displays).
  • Unified header/footer logo rendering via puffergo_the_logo() and wp_get_attachment_image (srcset-friendly); fixed plugin load order so site profile helpers load before header/footer context.
  • Refined logo-related admin strings and translations.
  • 账号未连接时优化引导：更清晰提示先连接账号再开始 AI 建站。
  • 站点信息：Logo 从媒体库选择（附件 ID + 同步 URL）；更新尺寸建议（宽度 200–400 px，建议上传 2 倍图以适配视网膜屏）。
  • 统一页眉/页脚 Logo 输出（puffergo_the_logo() + wp_get_attachment_image，利于 srcset）；修正插件加载顺序，确保站点信息相关函数先于 header/footer context 加载。
  • 优化 Logo 相关后台文案与翻译。

0.9.1

short_description: AI-powered website builder. Quickly create high-performance, Google SEO-friendly beautiful websites.
description:
PufferGo is an AI website builder crafted by a team of senior engineers from top-tier tech companies. Powered by world-leading large language models, it helps you rapidly generate beautiful websites optimized for Google SEO—empowering businesses to easily build their online presence for global markets.
PufferGo 是一款由一线互联网大厂工程师团队打造的 AI 建站工具，专为外贸企业和 B2B 出海商家设计。无需编程基础，输入业务信息即可由 AI 自动分析需求、规划网站结构、生成精美页面，一站式完成外贸独立站搭建。支持中文理解，提供完整的中文支持和微信客服。

Why Choose PufferGo?

  • 🌏 Optimized for Export & B2B – Purpose-built for international trade and B2B business scenarios.
  • 🔍 Google SEO Friendly – Semantic code structure that search engines love.
  • ⚡ Zero Coding Required – No technical background needed. Launch your site in as little as one day.
  • 📱 Fully Responsive – Perfect display on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • 🚀 Blazing Fast Performance – Clean, minimal code for instant page loads.
  • 🤖 Top-Tier AI Models – Integrated with world-leading large language models.

Core Features

  • AI Requirements Analysis – Input your business info, and AI organizes your website requirements automatically.
  • Smart Sitemap Generation – Auto-generates site structures following Silo architecture best practices.
  • Intelligent Block Planning – Plans optimal page layouts based on each page’s goals.
  • One-Click Website Generation – AI generates complete pages instantly.
  • Flexible Editing Options – Supports manual editing, AI-assisted editing, or importing HTML from other AI tools.
  • Theme Compatible – Works seamlessly with your WordPress theme styles.

Documentation & Support

  • 📖 Documentation: puffergo.com/docs
  • 💬 Chinese Support: We provide comprehensive Chinese support to help Chinese businesses go global.
  • 📧 Email / 邮箱: tech@puffergo.com
  • 💬 WeChat / 微信: 联系我们获取微信

External Services

This plugin utilizes PufferGo AI services (api.puffergo.com) to provide artificial intelligence features:

  • Content Generation: Sends prompts to generate text and layouts.
  • Template Sync: Fetches the latest design patterns from our cloud library.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

This plugin supports optional third-party analytics services that are disabled by default and require manual activation:

Google Tag Manager

  • Service: Google Tag Manager
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Google’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Google Privacy Policy and Google Terms of Service

Baidu Analytics (百度统计)

  • Service: Baidu Analytics (百度统计)
  • Status: Disabled by default, requires manual activation in plugin settings
  • Purpose: Used to analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns for Chinese markets.
  • Data Transmission: May transmit user IP addresses and browser fingerprint information to Baidu’s servers.
  • Privacy & Terms: For detailed privacy and security information, please refer to Baidu Privacy Policy and Baidu Terms of Service
